behaviors.description: Control retention of files used by a running app during uninstall.
behaviors.preconditions: Held-live independent app probe; an open descriptor identifies its deployment across directory renames.
behaviors.expected: Both uninstalls remove installed identity; ordinary uninstall retains running files, force_uninstall removes them; process is killed and reaped.

behaviors.description: Install directly from local repository URI.
expected: Native add_install accepts file URI, deploys exact commit, and installed origin resolves to a remote with that URI.

behaviors.description: No-deploy downloads update while preserving deployed commits.
expected: B payload is requested, A remains deployed, and fresh transaction getter accepts FALSE.

behaviors.description: No-pull deploys previously downloaded B without requests.
expected: Flag roundtrips and B deploys entirely offline.

behaviors.description: Explicit A update overrides advertised B.
expected: B deploys, explicit A update deploys A, unchanged runtime remains.
App and runtime retain exact installed commits.

behaviors.description: Cancel required payload after first byte while remainder is gated.
expected: Run returns FALSE and GError after synchronized cancellation; app A and runtime remain.

behaviors.description: Earlier completed operation survives later payload failure.
expected: Exact completion order and commit remain deployed after later failure stops run.

mappings.rationale: Additional public force_uninstall contract has no exact row in the fixed denominator; held running files distinguish TRUE from FALSE.

surface_assertions.rationale: A held running deployment remains with force disabled and loses its files when force is enabled.

mappings.rationale: Native add_install receives prepared file URI in empty installation without remote setup. Exact installed commit and public origin getter followed by remote lookup/URL verify the created source remote without assuming its generated name.
Getter TRUE, required payload request, exact A/runtime preserved, fresh getter FALSE.
Download B without deployment then no-pull deploy B with zero HTTP requests; getter both settings.
Install B then explicitly update to available A while server continues advertising B, verify exact A/runtime.
Ignored uninstall completes successfully and preserves exact app/runtime commits.
HTTP server sends one payload byte, records and publishes in-flight marker, gates remainder. C watcher cancels live run; require failure/GError and exact preserved A/runtime.
Deny unique payload of second resolved operation; first completes at exact B before failure, and remains publicly queryable at B after run fails.
